opening.argument: The video ties BitClub Network purchases to growing passive income, then describes paid mining packages, team recruitment, and commission payments. The speaker says buyers “will receive a steady growing fair passive income” and describes a 5% payment when people connect others who purchase shares. The displayed pages reinforce those mechanics with three priced Bitcoin-mining pool options and participant groups organized across team levels. It also presents a potential monthly income claim and directs viewers to the person who shared the video to learn how to obtain the stated result. Together, these are claims of paid mining and recruitment-linked returns, not verified earnings: the claims, payments, and outcomes are not verified.
